units.source_text: 有许多古色古香的建筑物，给人的印象仿佛是封建诸侯出巡的年代修建的。

en.t: There are many old-fashioned buildings, giving the impression that they were built in the age when feudal lords traveled in procession.

units.source_text: 二楼的纸拉窗只有一尺高，而且是细长条。

en.t: The paper sliding windows on the second floor are only about one foot high, and they are long and narrow.

units.source_text: 檐前垂挂着一张芭茅编的帘子。

en.t: A curtain woven from kaya grass hangs down in front of the eaves.
